---
name: frontend-design
description: Create professional tropical UI for Bici Vuelta Cuba with responsive and accessible interaction.
---

# Frontend Design Skill

- Start from user goals and current screens, not decoration.
- Prioritize La Habana and the route-discovery flow.
- Use a coherent tropical palette, strong typography, clear hierarchy and generous spacing.
- Design mobile-first; verify small phones, tablet and desktop.
- Include hover, focus, active, loading, empty and error states.
- Meet semantic HTML, keyboard navigation, focus visibility, contrast and reduced-motion expectations.
- Hand off concrete component states and acceptance criteria; avoid invented route imagery or facts.
